identity.description: Slack is an AI work platform for team messaging, with a developer platform (Web API, Events, Bolt SDKs) and an official hosted MCP server.
identity.identity_notes: Sources are official slack.com and docs.slack.dev pages.

auth.oauth_flows: OAuth 2.0 v2 authorization code flow (oauth.v2.access); oauth.v2.user.access for user-token/MCP flows
auth.token_refresh: Optional token rotation (cannot be turned off once enabled); rotating app-level tokens expire after 12 hours with single-use refresh tokens.
auth.scopes_notes: Bot scopes and user scopes requested at install; scopes are additive and cannot be downgraded.

access.production_restrictions: MCP use is limited to apps published in the Slack Marketplace and internal apps; unlisted apps are prohibited. Workspace admins may need to approve MCP integrations.

api.rate_limits: Web API tiers per method per workspace per app: Tier 1 1+/min, Tier 2 20+/min, Tier 3 50+/min; HTTP 429 with Retry-After. Events API max 30,000 deliveries per workspace per app per 60 min.
api.limitations: MCP server does not support SSE or Dynamic Client Registration.

claims.quote: Slack apps are installed with a v2 OAuth 2.0 flow.
Bot tokens ascribe to a granular permission model to request only the scopes you need.
No approval yet? Try it in a free Developer Program sandbox .
If you exceed a rate limit when using any of our HTTP-based APIs (including incoming webhooks), Slack will return a HTTP 429 Too Many Requests error
The Slack MCP server provides tools for searching through Slack, retrieving and sending messages, managing canvases, managing users, uploading files, and working with lists.
All requests should be sent to: https://mcp.slack.com/mcp
The Slack MCP Server lets AI apps search channels, send messages, manage canvases, and perform other Slack actions through any MCP-compatible client.
Remote MCP over HTTP with OAuth. Your workspace admin may need to approve it.
Only apps published in the Slack Marketplace and internal apps can use MCP at this time; unlisted apps are prohibited from using MCP.

open_questions: Whether a paid Slack plan is needed for full API features beyond the free Developer Program sandbox.
Marketplace app review requirements for public distribution are not detailed in sources.
